quality._doc: Flag convention. 'auto' compares point-to-point scatter of the flag==0 and flag!=0 subsets and keeps flag==0 (standard TESS) unless flag!=0 is clearly cleaner and big enough.

outliers._doc: Pass 1 before flattening, pass 2 after. Only upward outliers (flares, cosmic rays) are sigma-clipped; downward points are removed only when isolated single-cadence glitches, so transit dips survive.

detrend._doc: Savitzky-Golay flatten window in days (converted to an odd number of cadences). 0.5 d = 361 cadences at TESS 2-min, inside the 300-500 band. The window must exceed the transit duration and be shorter than the rotation period.

search._doc: Broad TLS search; period range 0 means auto (TLS default minimum, maximum = baseline/2 so >=2 transits).

refine._doc: Narrow TLS around the adopted candidate (source: +/-2-10%, +/-5% typical), then a bounded trapezoid least-squares polish of period and T0.
